newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts French share weighting.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts French share weighting.

text.p: Strategists at Goldman Sachs lowered their European equity portfolio weighting on French equities and raised their weighting on Switzerland, a research note from the brokerage said on Thursday.

Strategists Mike Young and Peter Sullivan at Goldman cut their weighting on France by 350 basis points to 12.1 points, with most of the reduction being used to increase their recommended weighting in Switzerland.
They said recent events such as the reluctance to allow cost-cutting at Credit Lyonnais suggested that the needed restructuring of French industry was being delayed.
Young and Sullivan said they maintained a major overweight position in Germany and were also overweight Scandinavia and Spain. They have major underweight positions on France, Italy and the UK.
